items.q: How fast did Opus 4.8 follow 4.7, and why does that matter?
items.a: It shipped **six weeks after 4.7** — the fastest Opus cadence ever — amid Claude Code search volume falling (~8.8M → under 6M) while Codex rose (~1.8M → 3M). BridgeMind frames it as Anthropic rushing to win back share after a 4.7 miss.

items.q: What stayed the same as 4.7 under the hood?
items.a: Same **Jan 2026 knowledge cutoff**, same hallucination rate, and same output-token profile — signals **incremental tuning**, not a new frontier model.

items.q: Where did official scores look good, and where did they regress?
items.a: Anthropic claims ~**5% SWE-Bench Pro** jump and **#1 intelligence index** on Artificial Analysis, but coding index still trails GPT 5.5 Extra High (**56.7 vs 59**). **CursorBench regressed**, and BridgeBench worsened on lava lamp, security, refactoring, and debugging.

items.q: Does a better HTML FPS demo prove production readiness?
items.a: A single-shot HTML FPS (map, kill feed, RPG effects) improved over prior Opus, but BridgeMind calls that **"not real software"** — the real test is production with subscribers.

items.q: How token-hungry was the Opus 4.8 stress test?
items.a: BridgeMind burned **2B+ tokens in two days** — 480M fast mode, **973M + 655M** in Claude Code — plus a third Claude Max for UltraCode. One day alone used **1.6B tokens** via UltraCode.

items.q: What happened when 105 agents shipped a BridgeSpace update?
items.a: They introduced a **terminal text-rendering bug** (v3.0.78). Opus 4.8 failed **8 fix attempts**; GPT 5.5, UltraCode, and Cursor Opus 4.8 Fast also failed — full rollback to a safe commit was required.

items.q: How expensive can parallel UltraCode get mid-video?
items.a: During filming, **15 agents** ran a classify phase; **two agents** alone used **~9% of one $200 Max plan** in about 14 minutes.

Yes — **stamp of approval** as best current coding model and better than 4.7 in many areas — but the creator is disappointed: **incremental not leap**, hype-driven cadence, Anthropic's own phrasing of a **"modest but tangible improvement."

items.q: What is BridgeMind waiting for next?
items.a: A **Claude Mythos** leap that fixes hard production bugs, not just pretty demos. Polymarket odds for Mythos by end of June jumped ~**10% → ~40%**.
